temporal_state_chain.observed: Marilyn has been unusually quiet and withdrawn over the past few days; when Carolyn asks, Marilyn says she is overwhelmed with work and personal stuff and thanks her for asking.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Marilyn is normally engaging and sociable, so her recent quietness is unusual; Carolyn does not yet know the reason.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Changed: Marilyn's explanation confirms that her withdrawal is due to being overwhelmed by work and personal matters rather than a specific issue with Carolyn.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Marilyn is dealing with stress from work and personal issues and may need support or space.
temporal_state_chain.intention: check in on Marilyn and offer supportive availability without pushing too hard

temporal_state_chain.observed: Marilyn responded curtly in a subsequent interaction; after Carolyn shares her own tough experiences, Marilyn appreciates it, apologizes if she seemed off, and says it has been a hard week.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: After the first check-in, Carolyn believed she had offered support; she did not expect Marilyn to be curt and worried she may have overstepped.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Changed: Carolyn's confusion and hurt are addressed when Marilyn apologizes and explains it has been a hard week, indicating the curtness was not personal.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Marilyn's curtness was due to her own hard week, not Carolyn's overstepping; Marilyn appreciates Carolyn's openness.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: confused and slightly hurt, then relieved and empathetic
temporal_state_chain.intention: clear misunderstandings and continue to show support while respecting boundaries

temporal_state_chain.observed: Marilyn responded positively to Carolyn's earlier openness and accepts Carolyn's invitation to a small weekend gathering.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Carolyn feels relieved and hopeful after their last conversation and believes their friendship is beginning to develop.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Changed: Marilyn's acceptance strengthens Carolyn's belief that Marilyn is interested in a friendship beyond work.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Marilyn is open to social connection and wants to attend Carolyn's gathering; the friendship is developing positively.
temporal_state_chain.intention: strengthen the friendship by hosting the gathering and including Marilyn

temporal_state_chain.observed: Despite friendly interactions outside work, Carolyn perceives Marilyn as still keeping a professional distance at the bank; when Carolyn raises it, Marilyn says she didn't realize it, apologizes, and agrees to talk about improving collaboration.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Carolyn believes they have a friendly connection outside work but feels Marilyn remains professionally distant at the bank, which she takes as a possible sign of rejection or unresolved distance.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Changed: Marilyn's surprise, apology, and willingness to discuss the dynamic suggest the distance may be unintentional or a perception mismatch rather than personal rejection.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: The professional distance can be addressed; Marilyn is open to improving their collaboration.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: disappointed and confused, then cautiously reassured
temporal_state_chain.intention: discuss their work dynamic directly and work toward better collaboration

temporal_state_chain.observed: After the private meeting, Carolyn believes they cleared the air and understand each other's professional expectations and personal boundaries; Marilyn agrees to team up on the new project and says she is glad they had the talk.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Carolyn believes she and Marilyn have resolved their work dynamic and now understand each other better professionally and personally.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Reinforced: Marilyn's enthusiasm and agreement strengthen Carolyn's belief that they have a stronger mutual understanding and a viable partnership.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: They have a more collaborative relationship with shared understanding, and Marilyn is willing to work closely with Carolyn.
temporal_state_chain.intention: team up with Marilyn on the new project proposal and further their partnership
